locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): masthead; communique, left column
independent_content_finding: The dated plenum communique names M. S. Gorbachev in the exact office on 5 February. Full name is corroborated by the July biography; no January-opening or continuous-term inference.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): communique, right column, paragraphs 5-7
independent_content_finding: The 10 July communique lists Avaliani and Gorbachev on the secret ballot; nomination/ballot evidence only.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): communique, right column, paragraph 9
independent_content_finding: The communique separately reports voting during the evening session of 10 July, without converting it into an office boundary.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): communique, right column, paragraph 11
independent_content_finding: The result and approval of the counting-commission protocol are printed for 10 July. An election event, not an assumed start.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): communique, right column, last paragraph
independent_content_finding: The final paragraph styles Gorbachev as General Secretary while reporting his address after the result. Supports the dated observation, not a complete term.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): biographical note below the communique
independent_content_finding: The adjacent biography prints his full name and dates re-election to 10 July. Retained as a separate biographical election claim.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): communique, right column, paragraph 4
independent_content_finding: The 11 July communique styles Gorbachev as General Secretary while reporting that he presided after the break. Separate intermediate attestation.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): communique, right column, paragraph 5
independent_content_finding: The 11 July communique lists Dudyrev, Ivashko and Ligachev as deputy candidates. No election result inferred from candidacy.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): communique, right column, last paragraph
independent_content_finding: The 11 July communique reports voting for deputy and control-commission chair. Distinguished from the next-day announcement.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): communique, first and second columns
independent_content_finding: The 12 July communique reports Ivashko elected and the protocols approved. No effective-day claim or holder start inferred.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): report under the heading of the congress chronicle, lower half, columns 3-5
independent_content_finding: The Pravda correspondents attribute the tally to the counting-commission chair: 150/4268, 3109/1309 and 776/3642. Printed thousands separators retained. Reported figures, not a recovered protocol.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): biographical note, right column
independent_content_finding: The biography prints Vladimir Antonovich Ivashko and states election on 11 July, independently of the 12 July announcement. Both remain separate event claims.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): communique, fourth column; page 2 (PDF p. 2): the list, first column
independent_content_finding: The 13 July communique dates formation of the programme commission; its list names Gorbachev with the General Secretary title. A list attestation, not a new term.

locator: Page 2 (PDF p. 2): the list, first column, lower part
independent_content_finding: The programme-commission list styles V. A. Ivashko as Deputy General Secretary; his full name is supported by the previous issue biography. Supports 13 July without resolving old Ivashkov spelling.

locator: PDF p. 5: issue line and editorial board; PDF p. 228: imprint
independent_content_finding: The editorial-board list supplies the deputy title. The imprint says signed to press 10 July; the cover says August. Retain a claim dated by the imprint with this disclosed limitation, not a start.

locator: Page 2 (PDF p. 2): first column, report, paragraphs 1-2
independent_content_finding: The page 2 article is signed TASS and reports Dzasokhov referring to Gorbachev in office at the 21 August press conference. Reprinted reportage, not a signed party statement; attribution clarified.

locator: Page 2 (PDF p. 2): first column, report, paragraph 2
independent_content_finding: The same TASS-attributed report names V. Ivashko with the exact deputy title and says he flew that day. The opening dates the conference 21 August. Accept only the attributed observation, not an appointment or verbatim transcript.

locator: Page 1 (PDF p. 1): statement across the lower middle of the page, columns 4-5; signature at its end
independent_content_finding: The statement is signed by the Secretariat and names Gorbachev in the exact office. No separate date; 22 August is the newspaper issue date and remains a publication-date attestation.

locator: Printed pp. 31, 32 and 34 (PDF pp. 31, 32, 34): speaker line and two passages of the President's report
independent_content_finding: The speaker is Gorbachev; pages 32 and 34 state he laid down General Secretary duties. Neither gives that act a date. The 26 August speech does not prove an August 24 until.

locator: Printed pp. 32 and 34 (PDF pp. 32, 34)
independent_content_finding: The same speech proposes Central Committee self-dissolution. A proposal is not a decision or accomplished dissolution.

locator: Art. 1024, printed p. 1429 (PDF p. 23)
independent_content_finding: Gazette article 1024 orders safeguarding party property and measures for workers of committees ceasing activity; signed 24 August. Does not itself dissolve the party or end a party office.

locator: Printed p. 11 (PDF p. 11): speaker line and speech, right column
independent_content_finding: Medvedev is identified on page 11 and refers to Gorbachev resignation. Another deputy reference dated by the 3 September sitting, without a resignation day.

locator: Printed pp. 11-12 (PDF pp. 11-12)
independent_content_finding: The sentence continues onto page 12 and states the Central Committee did not decide self-dissolution. Accepted as Medvedev statement, not a recovered committee resolution.

locator: Art. 1038: heading, printed p. 1445 (PDF p. 15); point 7 and signature block, printed p. 1447 (PDF p. 17)
independent_content_finding: Gazette article 1038 point 7 suspends CPSU activity throughout USSR; dated 29 August. Suspension is not dissolution and yields no office-end or lifecycle date.

locator: Point 1 and signature block
independent_content_finding: Both the decoded Kremlin capture and independently retrieved original-edition legal-portal page print point 1 and the 6 November signature. RSFSR jurisdiction only; 1992 qualifications are outside this 1991 claim.

locator: Point 3
independent_content_finding: Both editions print point 3 concerning party property in RSFSR territory. The current edition also contains a 1992 court qualification after point 3; provenance corrected. Original wording does not assert present validity.
